export_detectron2_to_caffe2: use Caffe2Tracer to export a detectron2 model to Caffe2 protobuf format for deployment
export_detectron2_to_onnx: use Caffe2Tracer to export a detectron2 model to ONNX format with custom Caffe2 ops
export_detectron2_to_torchscript: use Caffe2Tracer to export a detectron2 model to a TorchScript TracedModule via tracing
save_caffe2_model_protobuf: use Caffe2Model to save a Caffe2 model as protobuf files including model.pb and model_init.pb
load_caffe2_model_protobuf: use Caffe2Model to load a previously saved Caffe2 model from protobuf files in a directory
